questions.prompt: Who was the first US Secretary of the Treasury?
questions.fact: He created a national bank over fierce objection, arguing the constitution implied powers it did not list.

questions.prompt: Which vitamin is produced by bacteria in the human gut?
questions.fact: It is essential for blood clotting, which is why long courses of antibiotics can occasionally cause bruising.

questions.prompt: How many players are in a rugby league team on the field?
questions.fact: The split from rugby union in 1895 was originally about paying players for time lost at work.

questions.prompt: Which artist recorded the album Thriller's follow-up, Bad?
questions.fact: It produced five US number one singles, a record for a single album at the time.

questions.prompt: Which capital city is furthest north?
questions.fact: It sits just below the Arctic Circle, close enough that midsummer nights never fully darken.

questions.prompt: Which novel opens on the Yorkshire moors with a visitor at Thrushcross Grange?
questions.fact: It is narrated at two removes, by a visitor recounting a housekeeper's account of events.

questions.prompt: Which company created the Rust programming language?
questions.fact: It began as an employee's personal project and was adopted by the company after several years.
